review.notes: Full read-through of the 7-page OCR against the complete PDF text layer; physical p.4 was rendered at 130 dpi for the Results table (which exists only as an embedded image) and the GDM-MRCR row labels were re-verified with a 400 dpi crop; heading levels were confirmed from the PDF span font sizes (18pt sections vs 16pt subsections). All benchmark values in both OCR tables match the source. Repairs: one dropped page-break sentence, one dropped footnote body, one misread table label (12Bk to 128k), 17 glued table-cell line joins, one inconsistent section-heading level, and the Distribution bullet list normalization. No code fences; no figure-internal headings; the vertical spine text and cover page contribute no body content.
